verdict.rationale: Statsig Warehouse Native runs experiment analysis directly in your own warehouse and connects to existing datasets with no ETL. Custom logged events feed metric calculation for experiment outcomes, so metrics come from the customer's own warehouse tables or ingested events. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the metric-definition workflow (e.g., defining metrics from warehouse tables or SQL, metric types), PM-facing metric authoring detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.
Statsig Warehouse Native connects to your existing datasets and any source of experiment assignment data
Logs one or more custom events for analytics and metric calculation. Events are used to measure experiment outcomes and user behavior.
